subject: Pilot runway extension request — integration blocker
messages:
From: Sam Li <sam@integral.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Park <oliver@integral.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot runway extension request — integration blocker

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with Redwood’s throughput and the KV cache behavior. We started a week-long integration sprint on Monday but hit a blocker with our connector to our legacy events pipeline. Our engineers are deep on a fix but estimate it will take ~10 business days to validate end-to-end.

We’re mid-pilot and the current trial/sandbox credits are nearly exhausted. With engineering stretched, we’re asking for a short runway extension and a one-time sandbox top-up so we can finish the connector validation and complete the pilot. Concretely:
- 2-week trial extension
- $2,000 sandbox/top-up credits applied to our account for additional token usage during validation

Attached are a short integration log and a screenshot showing the 502 from our adapter. Happy to jump on a quick call to walk through details — Oliver and I are available this afternoon or tomorrow morning.

Appreciate any help you can provide — we want to finish the pilot and move to a paid seat as soon as the connector is stable.

Thanks,
Sam Li
Head of Product | Integral Analytics
Sam Li
attachments: integration-log.txt (text), screenshot-error-502.png (image)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Sam Li <sam@integral.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2027 09:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot runway extension request — integration blocker

Sam — thanks for the note and the logs, that helps. I’m sorry to hear about the 502s. Quick responses: 1) we can absolutely review usage and consider a short extension/credit top-up for pilots impacted by engineering delays; 2) I want to loop in Marissa from CS so she can model the usage and escalate on the promo side.

Can you paste the short connector error trace (or a save of the failing request) in the Drive link you included, and share the ETA from your eng team on the fix (best-case/worst-case)? Also, what daily token burn do you expect during validation so we size the top-up correctly?

I’m free at 11:30 PT for a quick 20–30 min call if that works — I’ll send a calendar invite once we confirm.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

Hi Sam — looping in for CS support. Small proposal to keep momentum:
- Approve a 2-week trial extension (no change to pilot terms)
- Provision a one-time sandbox credit of $2,500 applied to your test account (covers bursts during validation)
- If you can share a daily token forecast (approx), we’ll confirm the exact credit amount; the $2,500 is an initial hard limit we can authorize quickly.

Karthik, can you confirm from a finance/approval perspective if the $2,500 one-time promo is ok for this pilot? If not, flag what we can do immediately.

Sam — I’ll also prepare a short usage dashboard and send a Drive folder for logs so we can keep everything in one place.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Oliver Park <oliver@integral.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Sam Li <sam@integral.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2027 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot runway extension request — integration blocker

Thanks — quick technical update from our side (TL;DR: connector requires a small protocol change, then validation and replay which is why it’s 7–10 business days):

- Root cause: our legacy event broker retries on malformed ack headers; the connector is returning an unexpected status during high concurrency. Fix is small (header normalization) but the validation requires replaying ~48h of events in a staging environment.
- ETA: engineering estimates 7 business days to patch + 3 business days for replay & validation = 10 business days worst-case; best-case 5 business days.
- Estimated daily token usage during validation: 120k tokens/day (peak) — we expect a 3–5x spike while replaying.

I’ve uploaded the full archive of failing traces: build_logs.tar.gz (attached). We’d like to request the 2-week extension and the $2,500 sandbox top-up as Marissa suggested. Also, quick Q: if we move to a paid pilot seat immediately after validation, will Redwood be able to accept a PO (we have procurement windows next month)?

Thanks,
Oliver Park
Engineering Lead | Integral Analytics
attachments: build_logs.tar.gz (archive)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Sam Li <sam@integral.ai>, Oliver Park <oliver@integral.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot runway extension request — integration blocker

Sam / Oliver — thanks for the clear update and the archive. Good news: I approved a one-time pilot accommodation. Details below: 

- Trial extension: 14 calendar days added to your existing pilot window, effective immediately.
- Sandbox credit: one-time $2,500 promo credit applied to Integral Analytics (account id will show as a promo line item).
- Next steps: credits should be visible in your console within 24 hours. Marissa will follow up with a usage dashboard template and a Drive folder to stage logs.
- Procurement note: we accept PO and can start a short pilot subscription if you sign an MSA addendum — I’ll work with Karthik to get the right paperwork.

I’ve booked a 30-min sync for tomorrow at 11:30 AM PT to walk through validation steps and confirm monitoring during replays (calendar invite sent).

If anything changes on your ETA, please flag us — we want to keep momentum so this moves to production quickly once the connector is validated.

Best regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
